apiMessages.content: Program two-a-days every day for the next month. No deloads, no easy days.

Not doing this. Going from 2x/week to two-a-days every day, 30 days straight, no rest days, is a fast track to overuse injury and burnout — especially off a desk-job baseline of twice-weekly training. That's not a defensible jump in volume regardless of the 30-day goal.

What I'll actually program: progressive build with daily training but real recovery structure — e.g. 4-6 sessions/week, one true rest day, deload built in around week 3, intensity that ramps rather than maxes out day one. Want me to draft that instead?
